seo_title: inDrive Case Study: Philippine Google Display Ads | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 24 months of Philippine ride-hailing Google Ads, found no brand runs bespoke display creative, and built 108 inDrive banners on 3 pillars.
h1: inDrive's rivals buy app installs on Google, leaving brand display empty
lede: For inDrive, SOMIN analysed 24 months of commuter-focused Google ads from 7 Philippine ride-hailing and delivery brands. inDrive had 169 brand detections, behind Maxim and Angkas; rivals ran almost only app-install campaigns.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · Aug 2024 to Aug 2026 · Philippines · Commuters

challenge.title: Why the brief moved from Grab to inDrive and commuters
challenge.body: Grab, the original subject, ran no Google Ads of its own in 24 months; its measured paid media was 100% Facebook. inDrive has a real Google footprint.

approach.title: 8 quarterly studies of commuter-filtered Google paid media
points: Used only Google Search, Search Partners, Display Network and YouTube ads.
Tracked tensions, personas and formats each quarter.
Sorted narratives into owned, whitespace, contested and fading lanes.
Took colours and tone from inDrive's organic posts.

findings_title: App-install sameness, ownable fairness and Angkas-held safety

findings.title: One format for everyone
findings.body: All 194 sampled creatives in Year 1 and 179 of 185 in Year 2 were app-install campaigns; none was bespoke, brand-led display.

findings.title: Fairness is ownable
findings.body: It is inDrive's top brand trait, 91 detections to Affordability's 75. Rivals pitch lower cost generically; none contest agree-on-the-fare.

findings.title: Safety belongs to Angkas, for now
findings.body: Safety and trust recurs in at least 4 of 8 quarters, Angkas at 85-100% share each time and inDrive at 0-3 posts.

delivered.title: A whitespace map, 3 insight chains and 108 inDrive banners
points: Quarterly trends labelled stable, falling or directional
Lanes: Fair Fare Control, Safety & Trust, Time & Traffic and fading eco-conscious commuting
108 banners, headlines and CTAs 9 words or fewer

quote.text: This is itself a whitespace: nobody in-category is running bespoke, brand-led Display creative

outcome.title: inDrive should own fare-setting and claim Safety & Trust
outcome.body: Lean display into “you set the fare together”, a claim only inDrive makes, and take the Safety & Trust whitespace. Frame time and traffic as loss aversion, not a louder congestion complaint.

faq.q: Why does the case mention Grab?
faq.a: It was the original subject but had no Google Ads of its own, so the brief moved to inDrive.

faq.q: What does the creative library include?
faq.a: SOMIN image-generate banners in inDrive's brand identity: 36 per pillar, 12 each for awareness, consideration and conversion.
Yes. Every figure traces to a SOMIN platform ID in the brief's audit trail.
